description: Burkina Faso - Rainfall trend is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Rainfall trend in Burkina Faso at 5 km resolution from 2000-2017. Coverage: Burkina Faso. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
